title: A refused binary reload keeps the old score live
teaches: PacerRt.load is transactional: a refused carrier leaves the previously armed score, its table and its evaluator untouched. The refusal is reported by status and reason, and the next frame is byte-identical to the frame before it.
observe: The good carrier loads with status 0 and writes radius and blend.
Loading a carrier whose target join no longer matches is status 1, reason 9.
After the refusal the same clock returns the identical frame.
Reloading the good carrier recovers exactly the same frame.
